gloss: opposite side; the other side; across the way

definitions.gloss: opposite side; the other side; across the way
definitions.explanation: The side that faces you or is directly across from a reference point. Used for locations across a street, river, table, or other space.

examples.english: The station is on the other side of the road.

examples.japanese: {向|む}かい{側|がわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sit in the seat across from here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}かい{側|がわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A small village can be seen on the other side of the river.

examples.japanese: {向|む}かい{側|がわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new restaurant opened in the building across the way.

notes:
Common spatial term composed of 向かい (facing, opposite) + 側 (side). Very frequently used when giving directions or describing the relative positions of things. Can be used with or without a preceding noun phrase specifying what it's across from.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}かい{側|がわ}: the other side of the street
- ⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}かい{側|がわ}: across the street
- {向|む}かい{側|がわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross to the other side
- {向|む}かい{側|がわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: the house across the way

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{向|む}かい→向かい：03750_mukai⟧: opposite, facing — shorter form; often used as a modifier (⟦{向|む}かい→向かい：03750_mukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧)
- ⟦{反対側|はんたいがわ}→反対側：16780_hantaigawa⟧: the opposite side — more general; not necessarily facing you
- ⟦{向|む}こう{側|がわ}→向こう側：08504_mukougawa⟧: the far side — emphasizes distance; the other side of a barrier
